dialog.english:
��������We've been here before, but this
place still gives me the creeps...
dialog.translation:
Ya hemos estado aquí, pero
este sitio me sigue dando
escalofríos...

dialog.english:
We barely made it out last time...
are we gonna be okay?
dialog.translation:
La última vez salimos por
los pelos... vamos a estar
bien?

dialog.english:
It's fine... as soon as we find
it, we'll go back.
dialog.translation:
Tranquilo... en cuanto lo
encontremos, volvemos.

dialog.english: Gyah!
dialog.translation: Ains!

dialog.english:
Sorry, sorry! Didn't mean to scare
you, but...
dialog.translation:
Perdón, perdón! No quería
asustarte, pero...

dialog.english:
Tai! Guys! Have you all been
secretly following us?
dialog.translation:
Tai! Chicos! Nos habéis
seguido en secreto?

dialog.english:
More importantly, why'd you come
back here, of all places?
dialog.translation:
Más importante, por qué
volvisteis aquí precisamente?

dialog.english:
Sora came back to find something
she lost.
dialog.translation:
Sora volvió a buscar algo
que perdió.

dialog.english: What'd you lose?
dialog.translation: Qué perdiste?

dialog.english: Well, it's... not a big deal.
dialog.translation:
No es... nada
importante

dialog.english:
They locked Sora and Piyomon up
here...
dialog.translation:
Aquí encerraron a Sora y
Piyomon...

dialog.english:
Hey, Sora, did you find what you
were looking for?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Sora, encontraste lo
que buscabas?

dialog.english: It's not in the cell...
dialog.translation: No está en la celda...

dialog.english:
You must've dropped it when you
went through the hole.
dialog.translation:
Se te caería al pasar por
el agujero.

dialog.english: Yeah... let's check there.
dialog.translation: Sí... miremos ahí.

dialog.english: Nope... it didn't fall here...
dialog.translation: No... no cayó aquí...

dialog.english:
I mean, what'd you drop? I can
help you if you tell me.
dialog.translation:
Digo, qué se te cayó? Puedo
ayudarte si me lo dices.

dialog.english:
It's fine! Don't worry about it.
I'll find it if I keep looking.
dialog.translation:
Está bien! No te preocupes.
Lo encontraré si sigo
buscando.

dialog.english:
You're not hiding something from
us, are you? Like food?
dialog.translation:
No nos escondes algo, no?
Como comida?

dialog.english: No! I'm not like you, Tai...
dialog.translation: No! No soy como tú, Tai...

dialog.english:
Oowoo... this is a nice bracelet!
It fits my white body so well...
dialog.translation:
Oowoo... qué pulsera tan
bonita! Le queda genial
a mi cuerpo...

dialog.english:
Did someone just pick it up? This
is bad! We've got to hurry and get
it back!
dialog.translation:
Alguien la ha cogido? Esto
es malo! Hay que
recuperarla ya!

dialog.english: Wait, Sora!
dialog.translation: Espera!

dialog.english:
Tres bien! I'll be so popular with
this bracelet!
dialog.translation:
Tres bien! Seré muy popular
con esta pulsera!

dialog.english: A B-Bakemon?!
dialog.translation: Un B-Bakemon?

dialog.english:
W-Wait! That's what I lost! Give
it back!
dialog.translation:
E-Espera! Eso lo perdí
yo! Devuélvemela!

dialog.english:
Who are you? This is something *I*
picked up!
dialog.translation:
Quién eres? Esto lo
recogí yo!

dialog.english:
Give it back! That's important to
me!
dialog.translation:
Devuélvemela! Es importante
para mí!

dialog.english:
Then you and I can have a battle
for it! En garde!
dialog.translation:
Entonces luchemos por ella!
En garde!

dialog.english:
I have no idea what you're saying,
but I'll take it back!
dialog.translation:
No tengo ni idea de qué
dices, pero la recuperaré!

dialog.english:
The loser is moi. A complete
defeat.
dialog.translation:
La perdedora soy moi.
Derrota total.

dialog.english:
Thank goodness... my lucky
bracelet!
dialog.translation:
Menos mal... mi pulsera de
la suerte!

dialog.english:
A lucky bracelet? Don't you wear
that when there's a wish you want
to come true?
dialog.translation:
Una pulsera de la suerte?
No te la pones cuando quieres
que se cumpla un deseo?

dialog.english:
It must be a really important
wish.
dialog.translation:
Debe de ser un deseo muy
importante.

dialog.english:
Yeah... the truth is, my mom
doesn't approve of me playing
soccer.
dialog.translation:
Sí... la verdad es que mi
madre no aprueba que juegue
al fútbol.

dialog.english:
She's a flower arrangement school
head, and she'd rather I arrange
flowers than play soccer...
dialog.translation:
Ella dirige una escuela de
arreglos florales, y prefiere
eso al fútbol...

dialog.english:
Whoa! Do you wear kimono and all
that, Sora?
dialog.translation:
Vaya! Llevas kimono y
todo eso, Sora?

dialog.english:
Don't interrupt her, she's
talking!
dialog.translation:
No la interrumpas, está
hablando!

dialog.english:
So... my mom gave me this a while
ago. She made it with sewing
thread.
dialog.translation:
Bueno... mi madre me dio
esto hace tiempo. Lo hizo
con hilo de coser.

dialog.english:
And she used beautiful embroidery
thread, so I thought...
dialog.translation:
Y usó un hilo de bordar
preciosos, así que pensé...

dialog.english:
You think if your bracelet breaks,
your mom will let you play soccer?
dialog.translation:
Crees que si se rompe la
pulsera, tu madre te dejará
jugar al fútbol?

dialog.english:
It's not a big deal, but it's
important to me...
dialog.translation:
No es nada importante,
pero significa mucho...

dialog.english:
I'm sure your wish will come true,
Sora!
dialog.translation:
Seguro que tu deseo se
cumple, Sora!

dialog.english: Yeah!
dialog.translation: Sí!

dialog.english:
Huh! And I thought you were hiding
food from us!
dialog.translation:
Vaya! Y yo que pensaba que
nos escondías comida!

dialog.english: ...Tai!
dialog.translation: ...Tai!

dialog.english:
It was a joke! Don't get mad at
me...
dialog.translation:
Era broma! No te enfades
conmigo...

dialog.english: Hahaha!
dialog.translation: Jajaja!

dialog.english:
It must have fallen somewhere in
this basement...
dialog.translation:
Debió de caerse en algún
lugar de este sótano...

dialog.english:
What are you looking for, Sora?
If you tell me, I'll help look!
dialog.translation:
Qué buscas, Sora? Si me lo
dices, te ayudo a buscar!

dialog.english: It's fine! I'll take care of it!
dialog.translation: Tranquila! Yo me encargo!

dialog.english: Thank you... but leave it to me.
dialog.translation:
Gracias... pero déjamelo
a mí.

dialog.english:
Sora, what's wrong? You're acting
weird!
dialog.translation:
Sora, qué pasa? Actúas
raro!

dialog.english: I'm sorry, Mimi...
dialog.translation: Lo siento, Mimi...

dialog.english:
Oh! I was just a little
surprised...
dialog.translation:
Ah! Solo me sorprendí
un poco...

dialog.english: Okay...
dialog.translation: Vale...

dialog.english:
Sorry, Mimi. I'm sure Sora has a
reason for this.
dialog.translation:
Perdona, Mimi. Seguro que
Sora tiene un motivo.

dialog.english: I'll just watch for now, then.
dialog.translation:
Entonces solo miraré
por ahora.
